items.headline: Man Utd beat Leeds on penalties in Croke Park friendly
items.summary: United drew 1-1 with Leeds in a pre-season friendly and won 5-4 on penalties at Croke Park, Dublin.

items.headline: Radek Vitek joins Middlesbrough from Manchester United
items.summary: Academy goalkeeper Radek Vitek completed a move to Middlesbrough for £7m initial fee, rising to £14m with performance clauses.
